|translation='''Title:''' Rebel Tech.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: If deployed at a war room, add 1 to the Attack Run total (cumulative).

2: During your control phase, send this technician to the Used Pile. Search the Reserve Deck for Death Star: Trench and take it into hand. Then shuffle, cut, and replace.

'''Lore:'''
Del Goren is an expert in communications and scanner jamming. Before he belonged to Alliance High Command, he was a crewman on the Rebel privateer corvette Spiral.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese numbers two choose-one options.
